knowledge:
- key_parameters: profile1=First ChIP-Seq profile numeric vector (non-negative, same length as profile2) ;; profile2=Second ChIP-Seq profile numeric vector (non-negative, same length as profile1) ;; ratioAreaThreshold=Minimal area threshold for RATIO_AREA (default = 1) ;; diffPosMaxTolerance=Tolerance range around the maximum value to consider for DIFF_POS_MAX ;; diffPosMaxThresholdMaxDiff=Maximum allowed distance between two maximum values for DIFF_POS_MAX ;; diffPosMaxThresholdMinValue=Minimum peak value required for DIFF_POS_MAX ;; ratioMaxMaxThreshold=Minimal peak value threshold for RATIO_MAX_MAX (default = 1) ;; ratioIntersectThreshold=Minimal area threshold for RATIO_INTERSECT (default = 1) ;; ratioNormalizedIntersectThreshold=Minimal area threshold for RATIO_NORMALIZED_INTERSECT (default = 1) ;; spearmanCorrSDThreashold=Minimal standard deviation threshold for SPEARMAN_CORRELATION (default = 1e-8) ;; metricType=The name of the metric to create in MetricFactory ("RATIO_AREA", "DIFF_POS_MAX", "RATIO_MAX_MAX", "RATIO_INTERSECT", "RATIO_NORMALIZED_INTERSECT")
- alternatives: The metagene package on Bioconductor can be used as an alternative or complementary tool to generate ChIP-Seq profiles.
- when_to_use: Appropriate when comparing two ChIP-Seq profiles (e.g., different histone marks like H3K27ac and H3K4me1, or replicates) within a specific genomic region to quantify shape, amplitude, peak shift, or area similarity.
- pitfalls: Both profile vectors must have the exact same length and must not contain negative values ;; Raw coverage values are sensitive to sequencing depth and should be normalized to Reads Per Million (RPM) before comparison ;; Metrics like RATIO_INTERSECT and RATIO_MAX_MAX can be misleadingly low if there is a large difference in coverage amplitude, even if shapes are identical (use RATIO_NORMALIZED_INTERSECT or SPEARMAN_CORRELATION instead) ;; Functions return NA if specified thresholds (e.g., minimum area or peak value) are not met.

workflows.name: chipseq_profile_similarity
workflows.intent: Extract coverage from BAM files, normalize to RPM, and calculate all similarity metrics between two ChIP-Seq profiles.
input: align1.bam (slimmed BAM file containing aligned ChIP-Seq reads)
region (GRanges object specifying the genomic region of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the similaRpeak package and alignment packages ;; 2. Define the genomic region of interest as a GRanges object ;; 3. Extract raw coverage for the region from the BAM file ;; 4. Convert raw coverage to numeric vector ;; 5. Calculate total BAM records to compute weight for Reads Per Million (RPM) normalization ;; 6. Extract RPM-normalized coverage for the region ;; 7. Calculate similarity metrics using the similarity function
workflows.code:
library(similaRpeak)
suppressMessages(library(GenomicAlignments))
suppressMessages(library(rtracklayer))
suppressMessages(library(Rsamtools))

bamFile01 <- system.file("extdata/align1.bam", package = "similaRpeak")

region <- GRanges(Rle(c("chr1")), IRanges(start = 172081530, end = 172083529), 
                strand= Rle(strand(c("*"))))

param <- ScanBamParam(which = region)

alignments01 <- readGAlignments(bamFile01, param = param)

coveragesRegion01 <- coverage(alignments01)[region]

coveragesRegion01 <- as.numeric(coveragesRegion01$chr1)

param <- ScanBamParam(flag = scanBamFlag(isUnmappedQuery=FALSE))
count01 <- countBam(bamFile01, param = param)$records
coveragesRPMRegion01 <- coverage(alignments01, weight=1000000/count01)[region]
coveragesRPMRegion01 <- as.numeric(coveragesRPMRegion01$chr1)

metrics <- similarity(chr7Profiles$chr7.61968807.61969730$H3K27ac, 
                            chr7Profiles$chr7.61968807.61969730$H3K4me1, 
                            ratioAreaThreshold=5, 
                            ratioMaxMaxThreshold=2, 
                            ratioIntersectThreshold=5, 
                            ratioNormalizedIntersectThreshold=2,
                            diffPosMaxThresholdMinValue=10, 
                            diffPosMaxThresholdMaxDiff=100, 
                            diffPosMaxTolerance=0.01)

workflows.name: metric_factory_similarity
workflows.intent: Calculate specific individual similarity metrics using a reusable MetricFactory object.
input: profile1 (numeric vector of ChIP-Seq coverage values)
profile2 (numeric vector of ChIP-Seq coverage values of the same length)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize a MetricFactory object with specific thresholds ;; 2. Calculate individual metrics using the factory's createMetric method
